title: Filtration Group Panel Retro-Fit Kit
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
detail_text: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division intends to procure Filtration Group Panel Retro-Fit Kit on a sole source to Facet Filtration Group. The proposed contract actions is for parts for which the Government intends to solicit and award to only one source under the authority of FAR 6.302 Any questions should be e-mailed to: joseph.w.aprile2.civ@us.navy.mil Phone Calls will NOT be accepted.
